summary: Routine is configured against positive-animal-wellbeing.netlify.app, but the site's canonical tag, robots.txt Sitemap directive, sitemap.xml URLs and llms.txt all declare pawellbeing.com as the real domain. The routine is auditing an alias, not the live host. Re-confirmed unchanged on 2026-08-24.

Routine SITES config declares 'sentry: NONE' for paw, but a 'paw' Sentry project exists in the dower-digital org and the live site is instrumented against it. Until the stored routine prompt is changed to 'sentry: paw', scheduled runs silently skip error monitoring for this site. Re-confirmed unchanged on 2026-08-24 (project still present, config still NONE).
